text:
olivia (Finance Ops): FYI GammaAnalytics just pinged support — they got two PDFs for March, one missing the 'Reserved GPU hours' line (~$4,300) and the other appears as a duplicate but with the currency converted (GBP instead of USD). Both were emailed. Customer needs corrected docs for their auditors.

raj (Billing Eng): digging in. I can see invoice_job-10421 ran twice within 12s. The second run set skip_validation=true due to a retry marker. That would explain duplicate PDFs and missing usage if it read the usage blob mid-write.

tess (Revenue Ops): Their message: "INV-2026-0319.pdf (no reserved line) and INV-2026-0319-copy.pdf (GBP 4,300). Which is authoritative?" They're asking for corrected invoice + credit note.

marc (Accounting): We need corrected PDF and a clear credit note referencing the duplicate doc id; also VAT was dropped to 0% in both — they provided a UK VAT reg. Need this fixed before month close.

invoice-bot: alert invoice_service:job-10421 retried (reason: storage write timeout). tasks: job-10421 / job-10421-retry.

raj (Billing Eng): Relevant log snippet:
```
2026-03-19T11:42:03Z INFO invoice_service job-10421 start
2026-03-19T11:42:04Z ERROR storage PUT /tmp/invoice_INV-2026-0319.pdf timeout
2026-03-19T11:42:05Z INFO retrying job-10421-retry
2026-03-19T11:42:07Z INFO job-10421-retry completed (wrote INV-2026-0319.pdf)
2026-03-19T11:42:08Z INFO postprocess: validation skipped (env.TRANSIENT_RETRY=true)
```
Looks like the retry skipped validation/dedupe and read a partial usage doc. I'll force a re-run with strict validation.

olivia (Finance Ops): Please ensure we don't send any corrected PDF until we verify 'Reserved GPU hours' appears. We can't have multiple sends to customers.

raj (Billing Eng): Agreed. Plan: (1) run usage-aggregator verify for GammaAnalytics for Mar 1-31; (2) re-run invoice_job-10421-rerun with validation enforced; (3) create credit note CN-2026-0032 referencing the duplicate file name; (4) re-email corrected PDF to billing@gammaanalytics.io with cc:acct@gammaanalytics.io.

tess (Revenue Ops): Approve reissue + credit note. Add short explanation string we can paste to the customer: "We mistakenly sent duplicate invoice PDFs due to an internal retry; please use the corrected invoice and attached credit note for your records."

marc (Accounting): Approve. Please include original file names and UUIDs in the credit note footer.

nina (Support): I'll notify the customer with ETA and hold automatic payment capture for this account until reconciliation is complete.

raj (Billing Eng): Patching invoice generator to never skip validation on retries and to wait for aggregator commit marker before reading usage. Pushing to staging now, will run reissue once CI passes. ETA ~3h.

olivia (Finance Ops): Add temporary pre-send check: if expected line items (by usage>0) are missing, mark invoice STATUS=BLOCKED and create a ticket for manual review. Also log an incident flag so CS shows 'do not pay' guidance.

raj (Billing Eng): Will add that. Created internal ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-1309 (links to CN-2026-0032). I'll post progress there.

olivia (Finance Ops): Thanks. Please include a short RCA and the remediation steps in the ticket for the monthly billing postmortem. :eyes:

raj (Billing Eng): Will do. cc @eng-sre for storage consistency check.
